input_fields.name: session_inventory
input_fields.description: Observed processes/windows with stable IDs, version, document identity, modal state, and busy state.

input_fields.name: target_version_and_document
input_fields.description: Required SpaceClaim version plus path, title, hash, or other document identity clues.

result_fields.name: target_session
result_fields.description: Single selected session and stable window/process identity, or null when unresolved.

result_fields.name: selection_status
result_fields.description: One of unique, none, ambiguous, blocked, or needs_manual_review.

result_fields.name: blocking_reason
result_fields.description: Exact mismatch, modal, busy, or identity reason when not unique.

procedure: Enumerate process/window identities and record version, active document identity, modal dialogs, and busy indicators.
Filter by exact version, then compare path/hash/title clues; do not identify by title alone.
Require one remaining candidate, record its stable identity, and report modal/busy state.
If identity remains ambiguous, return needs_manual_review without focusing or clicking a candidate.
rejection_rules: Reject zero or multiple matching sessions, version mismatch, missing document identity, or a blocking modal.
Do not select by screen position, recency, or truncated title.
Do not close, activate, or alter a candidate while unresolved.
